name: Artificial
description: A generative artwork with a compressed neural network and inference engine onchain, plus a built-in marketplace.
about:
## About the artpiece

Artificial (2026) is a generative work by Han in which a small neural network is stored, compressed, and executed entirely within an Ethereum smart contract. Each piece holds an immutable seed; calling `artificial()` runs the onchain inference engine over the trained weights to produce a 32x32 grayscale image, and `artificialHTML()` returns a self-contained HTML document that renders it on a canvas. The network, its quantized weights, and the renderer all live onchain, so the work needs no external infrastructure.

## One of 256

Artificial is one of 256 sovereign contracts minted by the `ArtificialAfterAll` factory (0xa7a3022249415e25752c4cf8696c2418defdf2db). Each edition is its own independent contract with its own owner, seed, and marketplace. The factory that created this piece is recorded permanently in the immutable `parent` field.

## Built-in marketplace

The contract includes a native fixed-price marketplace. The owner can list the piece for sale at a set price, open to anyone, and any buyer can purchase it by sending the exact asking amount. Sale proceeds are credited to pending withdrawals and must be claimed manually via `withdraw()`. There are no royalties and no bidding.
risks: No upgradeability — contract logic is permanent and cannot be patched
ETH withdrawal pattern — sale proceeds must be manually withdrawn via withdraw()
No royalties — sales pay the seller in full and earn the artist nothing on resale
transferOwnership moves the piece off-market for free with no payment involved

artificialHTML.title: View Artpiece
artificialHTML.description: Returns a self-contained HTML document that renders the generated image. Open in a browser to view the piece.

artificial.title: Generate Pixels
artificial.description: Runs the onchain neural network over this piece's seed and returns the raw 32x32 grayscale pixel bytes.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The immutable seed that determines the generated image for this piece.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The current owner of the artwork.

currentOffer.title: Current Offer
currentOffer.description: Check whether the artwork is currently listed for sale and at what price.

buyNow.title: Buy Now
buyNow.description: Purchase the artwork at its listed price by sending the exact asking amount in ETH while it is for sale.
buyNow.intent: Buy Artificial for the listed price
buyNow.warning: Sends ETH. The exact listed price must be sent — no more, no less.

listForSale.title: List for Sale
listForSale.description: List the artwork for sale at a fixed price, open to anyone. Only the owner can call this.
listForSale.warning: Owner only. A zero-price listing lets anyone take the artwork for free; use at least 1 wei.

validation.message: Price must be at least 1 wei; zero would let anyone take the artwork for free.

cancelFromSale.title: Cancel Sale
cancelFromSale.description: Remove the artwork from sale. Only the owner can call this.

withdraw.title: Withdraw ETH
withdraw.description: Withdraw ETH owed to you from a completed sale.

pendingWithdrawals.title: Pending Withdrawals
pendingWithdrawals.description: Check the amount of ETH an address can withdraw from a completed sale.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer the artwork off-market to another address, canceling any active listing.
transferOwnership.warning: This is a direct transfer with no payment involved. Make sure you intend to send the artwork for free.

parent.title: Parent
parent.description: The factory contract (Artificial After All) that minted this piece.

ArtificialCreated.title: Artificial Created

SaleCanceled.description: Emitted when a sale listing is canceled.
